_doc: Piece 1 overrides. Only what differs from the base. The cue is a band lift in a ballad, not a hit, so it builds on reveal-silence and re-enables a slow crack.

motion._doc: Strata read as time, so the push is slow and nearly straight down into the deep layer: small horizontal drift, slightly more vertical. Slower zoom over 25 s so the stone breathes rather than dives.

light._doc: Warm raking light, as if the sun found the imprint through the crack. Hard on-frame step at the lift, then a slow rise the length of the phrase.

crack._doc: Re-enabled from the silence base, but slow: the fracture takes most of a bar to reach the doorway.
